query:
The club operates with the understanding that everyone shares their Strava after every ride. Based on the conversations, does this apply to every member equally? If not, who treats this differently in practice, and what in their behaviour shows it?

Options:
A. Lena and Marcus
B. Tomás and Ben
C. Derek and Yuki
D. Saoirse and Priya
context:
[1] (about=Marcus, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T14:04:00) Noted, Lena. I still think the group should have one benchmark hard route as the default. The dual-route is a concession to group retention. I accept that it works. But I would not have designed it this way from the start.
[2] (about=Marcus, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T13:52:00) Right. Next season planning. I want to put a vote to the group about the format. Option A: keep dual-route model, one harder one easier each Saturday. Option B: single route each week but alternate hard and moderate weeks.
[3] (about=Derek, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T13:58:00) Dual-route. I said as much in session six and I stand by it.
[4] (about=Saoirse, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T13:56:00) Dual-route. Gives us autonomy. The group runs better that way.
[5] (about=Derek, episodic, t10 @2026-02-14T12:23:00) For what it is worth, I think the two-route model is good for the group long-term. A nine-person group with different ability levels needs structured options, not just a single route that suits the strongest riders. The alternative is attrition.
[6] (about=Derek, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T13:43:00) For what it is worth, I have started to see Ben's point. The last two Saturdays staying for coffee have been better than I expected. I am not going to claim it changes my training protocol, but it is not a waste of time.
[7] (about=Derek, episodic, t14 @2026-02-28T12:35:00) For reference, I am going to stay for coffee today. I have been thinking about what Tomás said about group retention last week and frankly my wife has made a similar point about me spending less time on logistics and more on the actual socialising. So. Here I am.
[8] (about=Derek, episodic, t16 @2026-03-07T13:35:00) For what it is worth, today's ride was well-paced across the board. The Saoirse-at-social-tempo experiment works. I will stay for coffee again today since it went well last week.
[9] (about=Saoirse, episodic, t14 @2026-02-28T12:26:00) While we are doing housekeeping, Tomas had a word with me in the week. About pacing. I hear the point. I will not be setting race tempo on group rides from now on.
[10] (about=Tomás, episodic, t14 @2026-02-28T12:30:00) Appreciated Saoirse. The front group can still push, just not leave the rest behind on an unmarked section. That is all.
